Our detached homes offer generous space, high-quality finishes and modern energy-efficient systems that keep your home comfortable all year round. Each home can be fitted out to your personal taste, giving you the freedom to create a space that reflects your style.

Key Features
 • 130 sq m / 1400 sq ft
 • Air to Water Heat Pump System
 • High-efficiency heat recovery and ventilation
 • Underfloor heating
 • A2 rated timber frame with block outer construction
 • Triple-glazed uPVC windows
 • Custom fitted kitchens
 • Stylish bathroom tiling and sanitary ware
 • Designed for modern later living
